title: How to Build a ₹100 Crore Business With ₹0 (The Hidden Formula of Indian Entrepreneurs)
description:
Can you really build a 100 Crore business starting with zero investment

In this video you will discover the hidden formula used by India's most successful self made entrepreneurs to build massive empires from scratch This is not about motivation This is about real strategy case studies and step by step actions you can take

We break down powerful business models that require little or no capital and explain how to use leverage systems and market gaps to build something scalable and profitable in India

You will learn how Dhirubhai Ambani built Reliance without money how Narayana Murthy started Infosys with just an idea and how Flipkart used smart systems to grow into a billion dollar company

This video is perfect for aspiring entrepreneurs college dropouts side hustlers small town dreamers or anyone in India who wants to escape the job trap and start something of their own

Forget everything you've heard about needing money to start a business With the internet social media and digital tools available today your potential is unlimited

Whether you're interested in zero investment business ideas startup strategies digital business models affiliate marketing bootstrapped success stories or how to start a business from scratch in India this video is for you

Search keywords included in this content are how to start a business in India without investment zero budget business ideas in Hindi Indian entrepreneur success story Dhirubhai Ambani Narayana Murthy Flipkart business model scalable business in India and how to earn crores without a job

Subscribe to the channel if you want more real business case studies financial freedom insights and growth focused content in Hindi

Your mindset is your biggest capital Use it wisely and your journey from zero to 100 crore is absolutely possible
